workflows.deploy: local install, no server: gh pr merge, then landing-guard check on the merge SHA; in the main checkout fast-forward to that SHA (git rev-parse HEAD must equal the PR mergeCommit), swift test, INSTALL=1 bash scripts/build-app.sh (signed build replaces /Applications/Call Catch.app and relaunches). Tagged releases are separate owner-approved tasks via scripts/release.sh X.Y.Z, which also folds changelog.d/ fragments into CHANGELOG.md
workflows.qa: anthropic-skills:computer-use on the installed app (menu bar item, Settings, CALLCATCH_DEBUG=1 --test-bubble for bubble states); real-call checks with live Plaud are owner-run
